content: Temporal, Kafka, and Celery solve different problems and are not substitutes. Kafka = stateless durable event log for high-throughput fan-out/streaming; it does not track downstream processing success. Celery = lightweight short-lived discrete task queue backed by a broker (Redis/RabbitMQ), good up to ~10k tasks/sec/cluster, no built-in state/retry orchestration across multiple steps. Temporal = stateful durable workflow engine with built-in retries, timers, signals, exactly-once-per-workflow execution semantics, ideal for long-running multi-step business processes needing compensation.
